cic_header: Na'urar Lissafin Hauhawar Farashi ta Tara
cic_description: Mutane da yawa sun san game da Ribar Tara, amma kaɗan ne suka san game da Hauhawar Farashi ta Tara. Yi amfani da na'urar lissafin hauhawar farashi ta tara don ganin yadda albashinku ke buƙatar ƙaruwa don kula da ikon sayan ku.
cic_hero_subtitle: Gano nawa albashinka ya kamata ya ƙaru don ci gaba da hauhawar farashi.
cic_inflation_cta: Fita daga hauhawar farashi tare da Bitcoin
cic_next_learn_inflation: Koyi yadda hauhawar farashi ke aiki
cic_next_explore_topics_desc: Duba yadda Bitcoin ke da alaƙa da kuɗi, 'yanci, makamashi da ƙari.
